body: This appears to be lost in the new version. Shouldn't it appear at the top of  `_notification_forward` and the end of `_notification_backward`?
`_notificationv` was removed because it's replaced by `_notification_forward` and `_notification_backward` (corresponding to the value of the former boolean argument).
@dsnopek Do you know if it's possible/easy to test GDExtension logic here without having to do a whole GDExtension library build?

We could make a faux extension similar to the "placeholder" extensions used when we have runtime classes? See `ClassDB::get_placeholder_extension()` and `PlaceholderExtensionInstance`

I don't know if it would make sense to use that actual code, or just do something similar - but it's possible! It would be a bit of work to get setup initially, though
